name: Acceptor Transaction Log Report Request V 06
definition: The AcceptorTransactionLogReportRequest message is sent by an Acceptor to an Acquirer or its IntermediaryAgent to request a report service.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Set of characteristics related to the transfer of the request.

ReportRequest.name: Report Request
ReportRequest.definition: Information related to the report request.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC or a digital signature.
